_comment: The committed measured cost class of every registered MCP tool (design §3.1, RT-152). A declared class (internal/mcp/costclass.go) is at least this; a row moves down only in the commit that rewrites the tool and carries its cost assertion (RT-93, or the rewrite's own allocation assertion before RT-93 exists). "audit" rows are the read-only audit of 4200482a; "static read" rows were classified from what the handler loads, pending the §4.8 cost harness.
